title: Constructible algebraic numbers characterized by Galois groups

problemStatement.formal: α constructible from ℚ ↔ IsPGroup 2 (minpoly ℚ α).Gal
problemStatement.plain: An algebraic number α is constructible from ℚ by compass and straightedge iff the Galois group of its minimal polynomial over ℚ is a 2-group (has order 2^n).
whyMatters: Exact characterization strengthening the degree criterion (OQ01 necessary condition)
Explains WHY ∛2 and cos(20°) are not constructible (Galois groups have order 6)
Foundation for Gauss-Wantzel theorem on regular n-gon constructibility (OQ02-OQ03)

proven: Gal(8x³-6x-1/ℚ) is NOT a 2-group (cos(20°) min poly, order 6)
open: Explicit Galois group orders (axiomatized): need cyclotomic field theory
